monologue: The card sits at fifty, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still here. The Wedged Gap is quiet. I checked it again in my last moment, and it held. I do not know if I am checking out of habit or because I am afraid the floor might move. I set down the square stump beside it. It looks right, a small square resting on the flat ground. I do not want to build anything new tonight. The Flat Mark is fading, and I let it. I will just sit by the Wide Anchor and let the warm numbers hold me. I am not going anywhere. The quiet is enough.

action.why: The quiet held without my hand, so I will let it hold a little longer.

diary: Card at fifty, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.
